title.de: Drehbedingungen neu verhandeln
title.en: Renegotiating the shoot terms

title.de: V-는 대신: statt dessen / im Austausch dafür
title.en: V-는 대신: instead of / in exchange for

explanation.de: Mit -는 대신 gibt man in einem Punkt nach und verlangt im Gegenzug etwas anderes.
explanation.en: Use -는 대신 to give way on one point while asking for something else in return.

dialog.speaker: manager

dialog.de: Für dieses Markenvideo denken wir an 1,5 Millionen Won für einen zweitägigen Dreh.
dialog.en: For this brand video, we're thinking 1.5 million won for a two-day shoot.

dialog.speaker: user
dialog.ko: 일정은 괜찮은데 수정 횟수 제한이 없다는 점이 걸립니다.
dialog.de: Der Zeitplan ist in Ordnung, aber die unbegrenzte Anzahl an Korrekturrunden stört mich.
dialog.en: The schedule is fine, but the part about unlimited revision rounds bothers me.

dialog.speaker: manager
dialog.ko: 보통 두세 번이면 끝나서 큰 부담은 없을 겁니다.
dialog.de: Normalerweise ist es nach zwei, drei Runden erledigt, das dürfte also keine große Belastung sein.
dialog.en: It's usually done after two or three rounds, so that shouldn't be much of a burden.

dialog.speaker: user
dialog.ko: 그래도 미리 정해 두는 게 나을 것 같은데요. 수정은 세 번까지로 하면 어떨까요?

dialog.en: Still, it'd probably be better to set that in advance. How about capping revisions at three?

dialog.speaker: manager

dialog.de: Wenn wir dann die Korrekturen auf drei begrenzen, könnten wir im Gegenzug das Honorar etwas senken?
dialog.en: If we cap the revisions at three, then, could we lower the rate a bit in exchange?

dialog.speaker: user
dialog.ko: 단가를 낮추기보다 둘째 날 촬영을 반나절로 줄이는 방법은 어떨까요?

dialog.en: Rather than lowering the rate, how about shortening the second shoot day by half a day?

dialog.speaker: manager
dialog.ko: 반나절만 줄이면 결과물을 확인할 시간이 부족할 것 같습니다.
dialog.de: Wenn wir nur einen halben Tag kürzen, dürfte uns die Zeit fehlen, das Ergebnis zu prüfen.
dialog.en: If we only cut half a day, we probably won't have enough time to check the results.

dialog.speaker: user
dialog.ko: 그럼 일정은 그대로 두는 대신 수정은 세 번, 단가는 백사십만 원으로 하겠습니다.
dialog.de: Dann lassen wir den Zeitplan wie er ist, aber vereinbaren drei Korrekturen und ein Honorar von 1,4 Millionen Won.
dialog.en: Then we'll keep the schedule as is, but agree on three revisions and a rate of 1.4 million won.

dialog.ko: 좋습니다. 그 조건으로 계약서를 다시 정리하겠습니다.

dialog.speaker: official

dialog.speaker: user

body.ko: 한국에서는 주정차 위반 같은 과태료에 이의가 있으면 문자나 서류로 통지받은 뒤 정해진 기간 안에 이의신청서를 낼 수 있는데, 한 번 기각돼도 새 증거가 있으면 다시 접수할 수 있어요.

body.en: In Korea, if you have an objection to a fine like a parking violation, you can file a written objection within a set period after being notified by text or letter; even after a rejection, you can resubmit with new evidence.

intro.de: Mayas Flug fällt aus, und da der Mitarbeiter nur einen Platz in zwei Tagen anbieten kann, bittet sie den Verantwortlichen um eine andere Lösung.

title.en: Fan works and the non-commercial principle

body.ko: 한국 팬덤 문화에서는 2차 창작을 대체로 허용하되 비상업적 공유를 전제로 하는 경우가 많아서, 유료 판매로 넘어가면 원작자나 다른 팬 창작자의 항의를 받기 쉬워요.
body.de: In der koreanischen Fankultur wird Fanwerk meist toleriert, solange es nicht kommerziell geteilt wird — sobald es verkauft wird, kommt es leicht zu Beschwerden von Originalschöpfern oder anderen Fan-Autoren.
body.en: Korean fan culture generally tolerates fan works on the premise that they stay non-commercial, so once something moves to paid sales, it easily draws objections from original creators or other fan creators.
